title: SB031 · The decision (source scene 23D)
subtitle: Emotion Resolve · four shots, 8 s each · continues from s23-sh04 (approved) · generate sh05 first, its last frame feeds sh06–08 · Ranjith, 2026-11-08

panels.title: Crew wake and gather at the rail
beats: Same deck view as SB027. 0–2 s Raghavan, Babu, Sasi jerk awake on their mats.
2–5.5 s they hurry to the RIGHT rail (the boat's left side); Antony runs in from the bow, pointing; Aashaan leans to the window.
5.5–8 s all stare out toward the bow; nobody moves to help.

panels.title: Antony: Call Aashaan. Bring a rope.
beats: Antony, back to the left rail; behind him ~150 m off the burning vallam and Selvan's head and arm in the water (L86).
2.5–5 s the order, face just LEFT of the lens (crew aft). 5–8 s silent, grips the rail, ready.

panels.title: Raghavan: Don't go.
beats: Raghavan MCU, deckhouse glow far behind; his hand shoots out low and grips (out of frame).
3–4 s the line, just RIGHT of the lens. 4–8 s silent; the wrist is pulled free, his hand comes up empty.

panels.title: Insert: Antony frees his wrist
beats: CU: Raghavan's old hand clamped on Antony's RIGHT wrist on the rail top.
2.5–5 s Antony twists free; 5–8 s the old hand left open, then grips the rail.

panels.title: 3D blocking: who stands where
beats: Crew and Antony at the LEFT rail (boat's port side) forward of the deckhouse; the burning vallam ahead-left; cameras c1 (sh05), c5 (sh06), c6 (sh07).
